sentences: Despite a challenging industry environment, with India's smartphone market declining by 26% year-on-year in Q2 FY '26-'27 according to industry reports, Dixon has demonstrated resilience by sustaining its smartphone manufacturing volume at broadly stable year-on-year levels.
Rexxam Dixon Electronics, our 40-60% AC, PCB joint venture with Rexxam continues its strong growth trajectory, characterized by robust cash flow generation and an industry-leading ROCE profile.
And this year itself we feel confident that we are going to be somewhere around INR 6,000 crores in this business.
We feel that in next couple of years, this is going to be almost INR 15,000 crore to INR 20,000 crore business for us.

sentences: Our market position, customer engagement and manufacturing capabilities remain intact, and we expect 20% to 25% volume growth quarter- on-quarter growth as consumer demand strengthens and we have a strong order book.

Now that higher band of 5% is a very, very large element to support the export from India.
So quarter 2 against quarter 1, we are expecting a 20%, 25% kind of a growth.

sentences: Over the past few weeks, supply-demand dynamics are becoming more balanced, and we are beginning to see an improvement in customer ordering pattern, and we expect a high-double- digit growth quarter-on-quarter in the smartphones volume along with growth in selling prices by 12% to 15%.
We expect this vertical to deliver high double-digit revenue growth in the current fiscal.

The segment delivered a healthy performance for the quarter under review, and we expect 3x growth in the revenues in the current fiscal against last year with a huge uptake in order books from all customers.
Lighting, the JV with Signify continues to deliver strong revenue growth, and we expect the revenues to grow almost to 2x in the current fiscal.

sentences: We maintain our return ratios with ROCE at 45.1% and ROE at 32% as on December 31, 2025, demonstrating the fundamental strength and stability.
